allow: PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 60; Write-Output "Status: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; Write-Output "Length: $\($r.Content.Length\)" } catch { Write-Output "Error: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell($urls = @\("/routines", "/progress", "/progress?section=cardio", "/progress?section=sports", "/goals", "/schedule", "/body"\); foreach \($u in $urls\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000$u" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 60; Write-Output "$u OK \($\($r.StatusCode\), $\($r.Content.Length\) bytes\)" } catch { Write-Output "$u FAIL: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })

PowerShell($urls = @\("/", "/log", "/log?view=routines", "/plan", "/plan?view=goals", "/activities", "/activities?family=endurance", "/activities?family=sports", "/activities/climbing?tab=overview&range=4w", "/activities/running?tab=overview&range=4w", "/body", "/manual-log"\); foreach \($u in $urls\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000$u" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 90 -MaximumRedirection 5; Write-Output "$u OK \($\($r.StatusCode\), $\($r.Content.Length\)\)" } catch { Write-Output "$u FAIL: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })

PowerShell($proc = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = 54200" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($proc\) { $start = $proc.CreationDate; $now = Get-Date; $age = $now - $start; Write-Output \("Seed running for {0:N0}s" -f $age.TotalSeconds\) } else { Write-Output "Seed has exited" })

PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/activities" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 60; $html = $r.Content; $sections = [regex]::Matches\($html, 'data-family="[^"]+"'\); Write-Output \("Found {0} family sections" -f $sections.Count\); foreach \($m in $sections\) { Write-Output $m.Value }; $cardCount = \([regex]::Matches\($html, 'eyebrow|ENDURANCE|SPORTS|STRENGTH|BODY WORK'\)\).Count; Write-Output \("Approx eyebrow/section markers: {0}" -f $cardCount\))

PowerShell($urls = @\("/activities/notarealactivity", "/activities?q=zzzznoresults", "/activities?family=invalid", "/log?view=exercises", "/plan?view=schedule", "/activities/intervals"\); foreach \($u in $urls\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000$u" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 60; Write-Output \("{0} OK \({1}, {2:N0} bytes\)" -f $u, $r.StatusCode, $r.Content.Length\) } catch { $resp = $_.Exception.Response; if \($resp\) { Write-Output \("{0} -> {1}" -f $u, $resp.StatusCode\) } else { Write-Output \("{0} FAIL: {1}" -f $u, $_.Exception.Message\) } } })

PowerShell($urls = @\("/", "/log", "/log?view=routines", "/plan", "/plan?view=goals", "/activities", "/activities?family=sports", "/activities?show=all", "/activities/climbing", "/activities/running", "/body", "/manual-log"\); foreach \($u in $urls\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000$u" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 90; Write-Output \("{0} OK \({1}, {2:N0} bytes\)" -f $u, $r.StatusCode, $r.Content.Length\) } catch { Write-Output \("{0} FAIL: {1}" -f $u, $_.Exception.Message\) } })
